AgentCompass v0.6.7 changes what the task classifier answers and how a task's capability demand is derived, and stops coordinators from polling for a worker in a shell. It builds on v0.6.6.

- **The classifier names the work; the router derives the demand.** The classifier used to answer four demand levels, one per capability category, next to a work kind that overlapped with them. It now answers one of 11 work kinds (`creative_ideation`, `architecture_reasoning`, `code_implementation`, `frontend_ui`, `code_audit`, `exploration_forensics`, `web_research`, `visual_analysis`, `text_processing`, `live_loop`, `gui_control`), a depth from 1 to 3, and an optional second kind with its own depth for a task that spans two. The demand on the four categories is projected from those answers by one table, a dated maintainer declaration in [work-kinds.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.6.7/skills/agent-compass/references/work-kinds.md): a design rule, not a measurement. The question set shrinks to ten questions for every classifier, including Jev and Gemini Decision.
- **`divergence` is now `creativity`.** The category is renamed in the data, the tray, `agentcompass score` and the documents. Manual scores (`user-scores.json`) move to schema 2; a file in the old schema is refused, and `agentcompass doctor` reports it.
- **Aesthetics asks image recognition from level 2.** Level 1 reads design only; levels 2 and 3 take the weaker of design and image recognition, the facet tool operation already uses. A model that cannot read images no longer wins a task that judges how something looks.
- **An advisor-only account does not take a task that writes.** It is offered only where the route lists it as an advisor and the task's access is read-only.
- **`agentcompass score suggest`** lists manual scores that differ from what measured public boards say by at least a threshold (default 0.4 demand levels). It changes nothing; manual scores stay authoritative.
- **A coordinator ends its turn instead of polling.** When a launch has a completion watcher, `next_action`, the default rules and the skill now say: finish independent work and end the turn; the notification wakes the session. Sleeping or polling `paseo ls`, `get_agent_status` or result files in a shell blocked the session and spent quota for nothing. Launches without a watcher (CLI, Dot, Herdr) keep their instructions.

**After the update.** Ledger rows and dispatch decisions written by earlier versions carry the old profile. New routing is not affected and the tray hides rows it cannot replay; `agentcompass doctor` lists both files under "Upgrade checks" with the fix (delete the file). A routing decision recorded before the update cannot be launched after it; roll the task again.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.6.7/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
